## 6. Interpretation and evidence limits

- A string or method-name match is only a lead; claims require connected callsites, arguments/register flow and downstream effects.
- A stylesheet reference is not proof of final cascade order; report actual Work Set insertion and iteration order separately.
- disableExternal must be traced from writes to reads and then to changed property masks/behavior before assigning meaning.
- @font-face support requires a connected path from CSS parsing through EPUB archive entry lookup to Typeface construction and application.
- Absence of a match in partial decompilation is not proof that a feature is absent.
- No source, APK, decompiled tree or method excerpts may be published to the public pipeline repository.
